comparison.objective: Set two locking paper-cassette guides snug against an A4 stack.
comparison.physical_skill: Squeeze-to-release sliding adjustment and independent relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Both guides snug to the stack, stack unmoved, guide tabs released and locked; numeric snug tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Although both adjust and lock, cassette guides use independent squeeze locks and contact-to-stack positioning, not concentric screw/jam-nut countertorque or repeated articulation verification.
